text:
maria: Heads-up — planning a gradual rollout of the feature flag `safefallbacks` today. Target: 20% of traffic at 13:00 UTC, ramp to 50% after 2 hours if no regressions. Need someone to own the deploy and smoke checks. Also want a clear rollback key and safe default behavior. @aj can you take this?
aj: I can own the rollout. Quick q: what should the safe default be for legacy sessions? Keep them on legacy model A, yes? Also who will watch metrics?
maria: yes keep legacy sessions on model A. New sessions get fallback enabled. Kevin, can you wire up the tracing/alerts for model mismatches and error rate? We need alerts on >1% 5m error rate or latency p95 > 400ms.
kevin: On it. I'll add a temporary dashboard tile: "safefallbacks - errors & latency" and a PagerDuty policy for the 5m error rate. Will also add a log-based metric for fallback occurrences.
sophia: Config propagation note — feature flags are stored in config-service with 30s TTL on edge. When AJ flips traffic allocation we should wait 60s before verifying on the edge to avoid stale reads. Also remember we need to update the infra config in both eu-west and us-west regions.
aj: good call. rollout plan I'm proposing: 13:00 UTC -> set allocation to 20% via /flags API, 13:02 verify edge reads, 13:05 run smoke checks, 15:00 evaluate metrics and either 50% or rollback. Rollback key: set allocation to 0% and mark flag status as 'paused'. If that happens, we should revert the config-service commit id <commit-id-placeholder>.
maria: sound plan. Add a short smoke checklist in this thread so on-call has it handy.
aj: smoke checklist: 1) Hit /health -> 200. 2) Generate sample prompt against the new path -> ensure response not degraded (no hallucination spikes). 3) Check logs: no new stack traces in the last 5m. 4) Check tracing: p50/p95 within threshold. 5) Confirm fallback metric increments are reasonable. Command examples: ```# set allocation
curl -X POST "https://config-service/api/flags/safefallbacks" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"allocation":20}'```
And query edge to validate: ```curl https://edge.example.com/_internal/flag/safefallbacks```
maria: I'll be on-call during the window and watching the dashboard. Who's doing the actual flip? AJ?
aj: I'll do the flip at 13:00UTC. I'll post here when I set it and again after verification.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: feature-flag flip for `safefallbacks` at 2026-03-17T13:00:00Z by aj. Job ID: fb-roll-1765004321.
kevin: Once AJ flips, I'll enable a short 10m elevated retention for traces to make debugging easier.
sophia: small ops note: when you flip, please run `config-service health` and `edge-cache flush safefallbacks` in both regions. I can run the flush if you prefer.
aj: thanks — I'll run the health checks and ping when done.
maria: thumbs up. Remember to annotate the deployment in the release log with the Job ID and the commit id used for the flag change. If anything goes sideways, we follow rollback -> notify product, ops, and page on-call.
aj: posting status now: setting allocation -> POSTed, waiting for propagation.
aj: verification: edge read returns allocation 20%. Ran smoke checklist: health ok, sample prompt latencies within p95 threshold, no new errors. Holding at 20% for monitoring. :thumbsup:
maria: great. keeping this thread as the source of truth for any follow-ups. If we do ramp, we'll note time and new allocation.
kevin: monitoring looks green so far. Will call if we hit thresholds.
deploy-bot: Job fb-roll-1765004321 completed: allocation set to 20%.
maria: thanks everyone. Leaving note to ramp decision at 15:00 UTC. If anyone wants to join the quick sync at 14:55UTC, ping here.
